text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Teach,

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
It feels like forever since I've written a
whole
letter. Y'know, not just a card like
for New Year's
or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
I hope you don't mind. I don't feel like I
could do
a good job putting my feelings
to words if I was
talking to you
face-to-face.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
Don't get mad if I screw up any spellings
or
something either. You know how long
it's been
since I was in your class.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text: Anyway. Getting to the point.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text: I want you to continue living.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
I took a gamble. I told you I would give
you hope
for the future.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
Except, it's now getting late into the
fall, and
people's hopes for me still
haven't reached my
goals.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
Which means I haven't given you hope
either. I
don't even have to ask to know.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
But you have to give me one more
chance.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
The other day, another Umamusume
came up to
me and said I gave her the
inspiration to take
action.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
Now she wants to beat me, but I don't
want to
lose either.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
No matter how grim things look, a real
act of
hope is not giving in. It's about
going on to create
a miracle.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
I want my actions to give you hope. I
want a
miracle to happen.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Letter
text_block_list.text:
So, please watch me run in the Chunichi
Shimbun
Hai.
Sincerely, Nakayama Festa

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...Dad? Will you get me a sheet of
paper?

text_block_list.name: Old Homeroom Teacher's Letter
text_block_list.text: Dear Nakayama Festa,

text_block_list.name: Old Homeroom Teacher's Letter
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your letter. It's still
difficult for me
to speak out loud, so
writing is the best way for
me to reply.

text_block_list.name: Old Homeroom Teacher's Letter
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to say this to you the last time
you came
to see me at the hospital, after
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Old Homeroom Teacher's Letter
text_block_list.text:
I know I could've texted you easily, but I

preferred to relay my message
face-to-face. So,
forgive me for not
doing either.

text_block_list.name: Old Homeroom Teacher's Letter
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to content myself with passing
you this
letter the next time you come to
visit.

text_block_list.name: Old Homeroom Teacher's Letter
text_block_list.text: I am your...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So you really came to the Chunichi
Shimbun Hai.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Guess so. Your feet are all right?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yup. And now I'm gonna win! See ya
later!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hah...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It turns out she isn't always a
blabbermouth.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Here I am running in a G3 after a
triple-serving of
G1s in the Classic Triple
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're right about that.
choice_data_list: If it's 'Nakayama Festa,' she'll take 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I won't disappoint.
